fusions.name: Fulling Mallet
fusions.desc: Pounds the target flat, dealing 16 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Dropped Bolt
fusions.desc: Drops a heavy bolt of cloth that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets and 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Felted Padding
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Calender Roll
fusions.desc: Your blunt attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
